comments.why: Balloonfest as a classic embarrassing Cleveland episode
comments.text: The two best things denigrating Cleveland: Balloonfest ( [VIDEO] ) & your already mentioned Mike Polk Jr's tourism videos ( [VIDEO] & [LINK] ). If you can get past the dreary gray skies for 8 months of the year, Cleveland is cheap (even the nicer suburbs like Solon or Aurora) and has easy access to scenic western PA & upstate NY.
